classification_definitions.integration: Actual project service, OS socket, filesystem/store or process boundary materially supports assertions. Synthetic net.Pipe with handwritten in-memory responder alone is insufficient.
classification_definitions.unit: Local predicates/bytes or synthetic callbacks, including net.Pipe plus handwritten in-memory framing responders; incidental setup I/O insufficient.

classification_definitions.unresolved: Missing/ambiguous source or mapping; distinct from runtime UNKNOWN.
